test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A cylindrical pipe, open at both ends, has an external diameter of 20 cm and an internal diameter of 16 cm. If the length of the pipe is 35 cm, find the volume of the metal used in making the pipe. (Use pi = 22/7 )
solution:
**Given:**

External diameter = 20 cm

Internal diameter = 16 cm

Length = 35 cm

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Volume = π × (R² - r²) × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ R = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm

⇒ r = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 cm

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × (10² - 8²) × 35

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × (100 - 64) × 35

⇒ Volume = (22 ÷ 7) × 36 × 35

⇒ Volume = 22 × 36 × 5

⇒ Volume = 3960 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 3960 cm³.**
